correctness.rationale: The geometric sixteen-curve graph is 5-regular with 40 nodes, no triple points, and arithmetic genus 40-16+1=25. Invariant spanning tree consists of Q-E_i, E_i-L_{i,i+1}, E_i-L_{i,i+2}, 15 edges; its 25 complementary edges form five free C5 orbits, yielding integral cycle basis Z[C5]^5. Normalization of nodal rational components gives the claimed torus character lattice. Independently recomputed graph incidence/tree and orbit counts and checked point-count formula from component, node and branch orbits. Finite-field blowdown of degree-five conic point establishes motivic identity [U]=L²+(5-2L)[Spec Fq5], including characteristic two. Checked proof does not assume rationalized character lattice.

Resultary 2026/10/4 complex integral homology of the complement concerns a different invariant, and prior degree-five del Pezzo ten-curve boundary has Petersen not Clebsch graph.
